ભાવપત્રકને લાગુ {{ESTIMATE_NO}}
1

Payment Milestones: 10% booking token, 70% upon material dispatch to site, 20% post testing and PGVCL net-meter inspection.

2

Subsidy Disbursal: ₹78,000 subsidy is processed via the National PM Surya Ghar portal directly into the beneficiary's Aadhaar-linked bank account.

3

Statutory Clearances: Global Solar 2.0 manages 100% of PGVCL documentation, CEIG drawing approval, and bidirectional meter testing.

4

Installation Lead Time: Physical mechanical and electrical installation completed within 5-7 days of site readiness and material arrival.

5

Client Scope: Provision of shadow-free rooftop terrace, raw water connection for panel cleaning, and internet WiFi for inverter monitoring.

6

ભાવ માન્યતા: Quoted prices remain guaranteed for 15 calendar days from issuance. Metal and module price fluctuations apply thereafter.

{{MODULE_WARRANTY}} વર્ષ
  • Guarantees minimum 98.0% rated power output during Year 1 of commercial operation.
  • Annual linear power degradation capped strictly at ≤0.45% from Year 2 through Year {{MODULE_WARRANTY}}.
  • Guarantees minimum 87.4% of initial peak power capacity remaining at the conclusion of Year {{MODULE_WARRANTY}}.

2 12-વર્ષ મોડ્યુલ પ્રોડક્ટ અને મેન્યુફેક્ચરિંગ વોરંટી

12 Years
  • Covers all material defects, glass delamination, junction box failures, and frame corrosion.
  • Direct replacement guarantee facilitated locally through Adani Solar's Gujarat regional service center.
  • 100% free on-site replacement labor covered by Global Solar 2.0.

3 8-વર્ષ સ્માર્ટ ગ્રિડ ઇન્વર્ટર રિપ્લેસમેન્ટ વોરંટી

8 Years
  • Full OEM factory replacement warranty on inverter motherboard, MPPT tracking unit, and display.
  • Rapid 48-hour inverter swap-out commitment for clients located in Bhavnagar and Talaja.
  • Lifetime cloud tracking software and smartphone mobile application access at zero subscription cost.

4 10-વર્ષ હોટ-ડીપ ગેલ્વેનાઈઝ્ડ સ્ટ્રક્ચરલ વોરંટી

10 Years
  • Heavy 80-micron hot-dip galvanization guaranteed against coastal saline rust and structural peeling.
  • Mechanical engineering design certified to withstand coastal gale winds up to 160 km/h.
  • Zero roof puncture policy guaranteed with civil block anchoring and waterproof chemical sealing.

5 5-વર્ષ મફત સંપૂર્ણ O&M (સંચાલન અને જાળવણી) સેવા

5 Years Free
  • Bi-annual on-site technician inspection (tightness audit, thermal imaging, DC/AC breaker checks).
  • Free chemical-free deionized high-pressure solar panel cleaning guidance and seasonal servicing.
  • Priority VIP helpdesk queue for dispatching service engineers within 24 hours of inquiry.

6 ઝડપી PGVCL નેટ-મીટરિંગ અને રેગ્યુલેટરી રક્ષણ

Zero Risk
  • 100% guarantee against PGVCL application rejection due to engineering documentation or wiring.

7 ઇલેક્ટ્રિકલ બેલેન્સ ઓફ સિસ્ટમ (BOS) વોરંટી

5 Years
  • Covers DC/AC distribution boxes, MCBs, rotary isolators, cable conduits, and junction terminals.
  • Guarantees against loose contacts, burning, or insulation degradation under normal grid operations.

8 લાઈટનિંગ પ્રોટેક્શન અને SPD ગેરંટી

3 Years
  • Covers replacement of sacrificial Class II SPD cartridges tripped by high-voltage lightning surges.
  • Annual soil resistivity testing of the chemical earthing pits to maintain resistance under <5 Ohms.

9 સર્વિસ લેવલ એગ્રીમેન્ટ (SLA) અને રિસ્પોન્સ સમય

24-48 Hours
  • Inverter fault diagnosis within 24 hours of ticket logging via WhatsApp or phone.
  • On-site engineering visit and equipment restoration completed within 48 business hours.

10 વોરંટી ભાવિ માલિકને ટ્રાન્સફર કરી શકાય

Transferable
  • All module and inverter warranties automatically transfer to the new property owner upon house sale.
  • Free ownership record update in the Global Solar 2.0 asset ledger and PGVCL billing records.

11 વોરંટી બાકાત અને અણધારી ઘટનાઓ

Exclusions
  • Physical damage caused by intentional vandalism, external projectiles, or unauthorized 3rd-party alterations.
  • Natural catastrophic acts of God (earthquake, flood, war) beyond certified structural threshold.
  • Improper cleaning using harsh abrasive detergents or metallic wire brushes that scratch anti-reflective glass.

12 વોરંટી ક્લેમ પ્રક્રિયા અને સમર્પિત ડેસ્ક
